name: Pablo Sanchez
source:
Profession: Novelist
Favorite Place: Book Store, On a Bed

He is the one who you will definitely enjoy having a chat with.
His cheerful and gentle nature allows him to be popular with girls.
Then he said his love was only for his girl. he sounded pretty serious, but... uh, i don't know.
That said, he is very composed and also has a splendid career as an author.
